0a807e1938.q: How does Winsupply structure M&A deals to avoid traditional rollup integration?
0a807e1938.a: Winsupply integrates companies at what Greg calls local speed, avoiding disruption to customer relationships and operations. Rather than forcing rapid ERP conversion, Winsupply keeps acquired companies on their existing systems if they have sophisticated infrastructure and reliable data. The company maintains 680 locally owned wholesalers as separate C-Corps with local ownership and autonomy, allowing local presidents to make decisions on pricing, vendors, and staffing rather than imposing corporate mandates from headquarters.
